crossRefs.note: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he fainted, and…
For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

translations.web: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
translations.bsb: In which direction is the lightning dispersed, or the east wind scattered over the earth?
translations.kjv: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
translations.asv: By what way is the light parted, Or the east wind scattered upon the earth?
